title: Che Maheene ka musafir
body:
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir Qatl Pyaasa Hogaya
Ghamzada Madar ki Duniya Me Andhera Hogaya
1. Jab Ali Asgher Ne Pheri Sookhe Hotou'n Par Zubaa'ñ
Muztarib Karbobala Ka Zarra Zarra Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dekh Kar Asgher Ka Laasha Fatima Ne Di Sada Phir Mere Mohsin Ka Haaye Zakhm Taaza Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aaj Tak Saare Jahaa'n Se Poochhti Hai Karbala
Ek Sawaal e AaB Par Ye Zulm Kaisa Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sheh Ne Chehre Par Mala Hai Jab Lahu Besheer Ka
Mustafa Ke Deen Ka Bhi Surkh Chehra Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zakhm Nanhe SE Gale Ka Maa Se Ye Kehne Laga
Nehr, Teer e Hurmula Se jhoole Waala Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aag Khaimou Me Lagi Jab Maa Tadapti Rehgayi
Dekhte Hi Dekhte Bas Raakh Jhoola Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kehke Ye Roti Rahi Hai'n Umr Bhar Umme Rabaab
Haaye Kya Soncha Tha Maine Aur Ye Kya Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jab Padi Bhai Ke Laashe Par Sakina Ki Nazar
Gham Se Maasooma Ka Dil Bhi Paara Paara Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aalam e Ghurbat Me Jisko Sheh Ne Dafnaya Kamaal
Uski Nanhi Qabr Par Naize Ka Hamla Hogaya
<<MINI>>
Chhe Maheene Ka Musafir...(x2)
